review.notes: Full review of da750f5; all six r9 findings repaired. Gate rerun: every check 0, OK. Depcheck: 245 roadmaps, 2479 edges, 0 problems. Suggested.lean elaborates with 32 sorry warnings and no error; #check pass done, the 11 dropped-binder leads are false positives; one-tactic probe closes none of the 32 theorems. Sample checked at the text: 0.3 (Horesh-Karasik B.4-B.6, A.1, A.3), 1.1 (Couveignes arXiv v2 p.6), 2.2/2.4/2.6 (Voight v1.0.7u ch.9; Schulze-Pillot 9.9-9.21; Kirschmer 3.1-3.3; GHY (7.1)), 2.9 (KSS), 3.3 (values recomputed), 4.2 (Koopman, exterior, rescaling and Poisson Checks recomputed; Last-Penrose and Kallenberg not readable), 4.7, 5.1 (LLL OCR), 6.2/6.6/6.6a/6.8 (Schlichting2010; 6.6a cites 8.1 p.140 for 8.2 p.141 material), 6.11 (CDH III 3.2.7, 3.2.10). R01 (P2): Poisson random measures duplicate PointProcesses, which MarkovChainsAndRenewal on main already consumes, and the stable stems duplicate HomotopySpheres 3A.3; neither is needed by any target here, so the repair is narrowing (tested: Suggested.lean without the Poisson section elaborates). P3: 3.3.5 d>=2 vs Scope's Q claim (formula verified at K=Q, Z^3, mass 1/48); Layer 2 intro characteristic-zero slip; 6.6a locators; 6.8 and 4.2 citations without exact locators. Left for a human: Wall forms/L_n(Z) duplicate HomotopySpheres 7B-7C, and the F2 Arf algebra duplicates the GeometricTopology revision 4.3.1; 6.10a needs them and neither owner may be cited.
